notes.title: Card Chronicles Update 2024-09-06
notes.content:
Hello Deckbuilders,

This week, there won’t be a new game update, as I’m focused on refactoring the codebase. I realized it had become too messy, which would make it difficult to implement the way resources should work and add new features down the line. Refactoring now will make everything much smoother in the future.

The work is progressing well. I’ve already adjusted stats, resources, ailments, and bonuses. Additionally, the battle flow has been made far more modular, breaking it down into tiny actions like drawing cards, dealing damage, updating damage based on card effects, and resolving all effects. This approach will allow for more complex interactions in the game.

Thank you for your patience, and I look forward to sharing the improvements with you soon!

Best regards,
Jan-Joachim Müller

notes.title: Demo Update Version 0.6.2
notes.content:
Good evening everyone,

Let's jump right in and talk about what I did not manage to achieve this week. It was a busy week filled with new tasks, and in order to stay on top of things, I had to prioritize. Unfortunately, this meant I wasn't able to implement new enemies, resources, or cards.

However, the good news is that I have already written all 35 new cards for the Brute, along with their stats. Implementing these cards will be relatively quick, though their stats may need some adjustments.

Despite these setbacks, I did manage to update the UI, adjust some text, and add status ailments. That’s right—some cards will now inflict BLEED or BURN, which deal a certain amount of damage over a set number of battle turns.

Additionally, for those playing on WebGL via itch.io, I’ve added a fullscreen button, making the game even more enjoyable. I understand this might not be as exciting for those using Steam, but it's a nice improvement for our web-based players.

There is still a lot of work to be done to get everything just right, and I am truly grateful to all who have played the game and provided feedback through itch.io or the ongoing Indie Playtest Fest.

Stay tuned, and enjoy playing Card Chronicles: Devious Deck!

Best regards,
Jan-Joachim Müller

notes.title: Demo Update Version 0.6.1

Hello Deckbuilders,

This week, my main focus was on enhancing the UI with more information. I’ve added tooltips and adjusted the deck builder interface to make navigation and deck-building easier.

Stay tuned, and enjoy playing Card Chronicles: Devious Deck!

notes.title: Demo Update Version 0.5.2
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

Today’s post is coming to you a day ahead of the regular schedule with the latest changes I’ve made to Card Chronicles: Devious Deck.

To enhance card synergies that make more sense, I’ve adjusted several card effects. Building on the central mechanic where each card played costs health points, I’ve added more events and specific world cards. One card I’m particularly excited about is LOOP+, which has an 80% chance to reset your current HP to what it was at the start of the last dungeon floor.

I’ve also started updating the tutorial. The previous version felt like a boring wall of text, and let’s be honest, nobody wants to read that much.

Additionally, I’ve adjusted the overall UI structure to ensure a coherent style.

I hope these changes will make the game more enjoyable. Have fun playing!

To finish today post, I want to let you know that I won’t be able to update the game next week as I’ll be visiting my family.

Best Regards,
Jan-Joachim Müller

notes.title: Demo Update Version 0.5.1
notes.content:
Hello there, fellow deckbuilders,

As previously mentioned, I am eagerly working on implementing a more cohesive card design to generate cards that synergize well with each other.

This week, I took a huge step forward by making resources in battle permanent, meaning they will not reset after each turn. Additionally, I have introduced a new resource: RAGE.

RAGE is a character-specific resource bound to The Brute, who, above all else, aims to deal massive amounts of damage when in a rage-like state. Therefore, stackable RAGE was implemented to later convert it into damage, given specific cards are played.

Furthermore, all cards in the demo were adjusted to ensure that playing different cards has more impact.

In the coming weeks, further adjustments and appropriate cards will be added to the game. Additionally, more content will be introduced after redesigning the tutorial.

I hope you have a fun time testing this build, and I am eager to receive any feedback concerning the new updates.

Have a fun time playing!

Best Regards,
Jan-Joachim Müller

notes.title: Demo Update Version 0.5.0
notes.content:
Hello all,

As previously announced, this week I focused on significant updates to several core systems to enhance your experience while playing Card Chronicles: Devious Deck.

I revised the background calculations during battles and improved enemy behavior. These changes were essential to ensure that your choices in battle have a meaningful impact.

Several bugs were fixed, more sound effects were added, visuals were improved, and some stats were adjusted.

In future updates, these core system improvements will allow for specific card synergies and diverse enemy behaviors tailored to each enemy's lore.

New content will be added once the battle and deckbuilder mechanics are properly implemented.

Have a fun time and see you in the next update!

If you have any spare time, I would greatly appreciate your feedback on the new changes.

Until next time,
Jan-Joachim Müller
